podcast.body: A 16-week number one hit for Boyz II Men and Mariah Carey. At the time "Uptown Funk" achieved its 14-week run, this song held the record for the longest continuous stay at number one on the Hot 100, highlighting a significant benchmark in chart history. "Mariah Carey and Boys to Men's 16 week number one one sweet day."

podcast.body: This duet with Mariah Carey dropped in November 1995 and achieved unprecedented chart success. It not only debuted at number one but also remained at the top of the Hot 100 for a then-record 16 weeks, solidifying its place in chart history. "When her duet with R&B vocal troupe Bois to Men one sweet day dropped in November, it not only debuted at number 1, it stayed on top for a then record 16 weeks."
